name: MEDIAPRONET API
description: Anonymous read-only JSON API for the MEDIAPRONET launch and discovery directory: category tree with listing counts, latest approved listings, trending listings, site of the day, topic tags and tech stacks.
notes: Free GET endpoints with no key and no account, described by a public OpenAPI 3.1 file, plus a read-only remote MCP server (https://mediapronet.com/api/mcp, Streamable HTTP) whose tools search listings, read full listing profiles and find alternatives to a product, so AI agents can look up newly launched startups, SaaS and AI tools.
